text: the cat sat on the mat and looked at the sun
i like to read books and play games with my friends
the sky is blue and the clouds are white and soft
she walked to the store to buy some milk and bread
the dog ran fast across the green field near the house
we had fun playing in the park after school today
he ate breakfast early and then went to work with his brother
the flower grew tall in the warm garden behind our home
i am happy to see you and your family this weekend
the bird sang a sweet song while sitting on the old tree
